surfaces.label: Public share beta tokens gain the owner's MCP retrieval scope
surfaces.notes: Source validated; web/src/components/embed-dialog/use-show-embed-dialog.ts:44, web/src/components/embed-dialog/index.tsx:184, internal/service/api_token.go:96, internal/handler/auth.go:138, internal/router/router.go:219, internal/handler/mcp_server.go:99, internal/handler/mcp_server.go:67, internal/handler/mcp_retrieval.go:62. Normal resource permission checks execute, but against the owner. Ordinary protected routes do not accept beta tokens. No exploit executed.

surfaces.label: API and beta keys survive account deactivation
surfaces.notes: Source validated; internal/admin/service.go:456, internal/dao/api_token.go:48, internal/service/user.go:776, internal/service/stub.go:74, internal/handler/auth.go:172, internal/handler/common.go:79. New password login checks IsActive and existing session tokens are invalidated. This is not an arbitrary cross-tenant bypass. OSS tenant resolver does not add an active-user check.

surfaces.label: Disabling password login does not block password authentication
surfaces.notes: Source validated; internal/server/config/api_server_config.go:95, internal/service/system.go:43, internal/router/router.go:167, internal/handler/user.go:236, internal/service/user.go:308. The setting defaults false. Password verification and disabled-user rejection still work; externally enforced gateway restrictions can mitigate reachability.

surfaces.label: Administrative password reset leaves existing sessions valid
surfaces.notes: Source validated; internal/admin/service.go:397, internal/service/user.go:515, internal/service/user.go:680, internal/common/token.go:34. Self-service password updates rotate AccessToken; session signatures and 24-hour expiration still work. API key lifecycle is a separate policy.

surfaces.label: API and Admin listeners ignore configured bind hosts
surfaces.notes: Source validated; internal/server/config/api_server_config.go:71, internal/server/config/admin_config.go:38, internal/server/api/server.go:376, internal/server/admin/server.go:85, internal/server/admin/server.go:109. Local lab publishes only 127.0.0.1:18080 and no raw 9380/9381 ports. Listener exposure does not itself bypass application authentication.

surfaces.label: Elasticsearch HTTPS client skips certificate verification
surfaces.notes: Source validated; internal/server/config/doc_engine_config.go:53, internal/engine/elasticsearch/client.go:43. This does not create remote access without network interception. No traffic was intercepted and default HTTP is a separate transport-security limitation.

surfaces.label: MinIO HTTPS defaults to disabled certificate verification
surfaces.notes: Source validated; docker/service_conf.yaml.template:45, internal/server/config/storage_engine_config.go:77, internal/server/config/storage_engine_config.go:116, internal/storage/minio.go:57. Explicit minio.verify:true enables verification and mitigates this issue. Default secure:false does not perform TLS at all.

surfaces.label: Shared URL fetching and ALLOW_ANY_HOST
surfaces.notes: Inspected guards validate schemes/addresses, pin DNS and constrain redirects; ALLOW_ANY_HOST intentionally broadens private access. Local LLM drivers use scheme-only transport, so no universal SSRF guarantee. internal/common/allow_private_host.go:28-65; internal/utility/ssrf.go:31-80; internal/entity/models/lmstudio.go:35-42.

surfaces.label: OSS SSO, operation audit and roles
surfaces.notes: OAuth and audit implementations are !ee no-ops, not bypassed implementations. Community ownership/membership remains. internal/common/stub.go:36-60; internal/server/config/stub.go:90-113; internal/permission/stub.go:27-38.

surfaces.label: Local and external code execution providers
surfaces.notes: Local explicitly executes with host-process privileges, operator-selected behavior; no default RCE claim. External Manager/Runner implementation absent; privileged+Docker socket in docker/docker-compose-base.yml:228-257 requires separate dedicated execution host and deployed-image verification.

surfaces.label: Committed RSA password transport key and session cryptography
surfaces.notes: RSA key is shared password payload obfuscation, not HMAC signing secret; HTTPS required. Current session HMAC-SHA256 has 86400-second expiry and DB token check. internal/common/password.go:172-240; internal/common/token.go:34-99; internal/server/variable.go:91-106.

surfaces.label: Unregistered password-change helper
surfaces.notes: Conditional old-password validation in UserService.ChangePassword is not reached by registered OSS routes. Active PATCH users/me verifies old password. internal/router/router.go:241-255; internal/service/user.go:651-689,721-744.

surfaces.label: Unauthenticated admin service reports
surfaces.notes: /api/v1/admin/reports accepts monitoring heartbeats without auth; spoofing and unbounded names warrant isolation/auth/limits. No SSRF/RCE proved: service control methods unimplemented. internal/admin/router.go:39-52; internal/admin/state.go:39-102.
